name: Last Days of Tsufana
storyline:
Tsufana.

Our world. Our home.

It was prosperous once. Richly abundant with wildlife, greenery, and... magic.

Guided by the zenith of human civilization: the Lispens.

They had ascended like no others before them. Lead the world into an age of prosperity thought impossible.

Coddled by Myrtir, their benevolent deity, the Lispens utilized a source of power known as Creta—phenomenal, otherworldly things. A gift from their overseer. It was through her grace they had achieved feats of miraculous healing and horrific destruction the world had never seen.

But then she departed.

The Lispens were abandoned. Forgotten.

So their reign ended, and the world they'd forged collapsed and faded into obscurity.

In the shadow of the paradise the Lispens left behind, a powerful sorcerer conjures a dream. A curse. A terrible affliction that has swept across Tsufana, causing some to disappear and most to transform into horrific beasts.

As the world crumbles around them, two youths have made it their life's mission to end the machinations of the madman who has single-handedly thrust their world into chaos.

summary:
The world descends into ruin. Its inhabitants have become monstrous abominations, with those fortunate enough to survive slowly succumbing to a mysterious dream. In the wake of the Goddess's departure, Tsufana encroaches upon the end of its days.

The player assumes the role of Falcon, one of two siblings whose lives were upended by the villainous machinations of Valdisna, a vile sorcerer who has ensnared the world of Tsufana in a wicked curse, causing the afflicted to become horrifying monsters. Vowing to put an end to Valdisna's schemes, Falcon and his sister set out into the collapsing world to end the sorcerer's reign of terror.
